data.rationale: ContinuityExpert predicts which context items (KTs, decisions, tasks, handoffs) to restore during session recovery. Learns from: recovery session patterns, entity usage, topic-to-entity mappings, recency weights, and entity co-occurrence. Integrated into ExpertConsolidator registry. Embodies the insight: 'I am not my context - I am the PATTERN of reasoning preserved across contexts.'
data.title: Designed ContinuityExpert for Hubris MoE system
